content: अभिग्रह् (<ab>Ved.</ab> ग्रभ्) €9 <ab>U.</ab> .²1 To take or seize, catch, catch hold of, seize forcibly, attack; रिपुणाभिगृह्य <ls>Dk. 5</ls>, <ls n="Dk.">98</ls>, <ls n="Dk.">103</ls>. .²2 To accept, take. .²3 To receive (as a guest). .²4 To fold, lay or bring together (as the hands). .²5 To set, show or bring forth (as blossom, fruit <ab>&c.</ab>). . --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} To catch or surprise one in the very act, to let oneself be so caught; अर्यवर्यस्य कस्यचिद् गृहे चोरयित्वा रूपाभिग्राहितो बद्धः <ls>Dk. 96</ls>.
